description: This file defines a React component for a 'Save Chart' modal in the Apache Superset frontend. It manages saving, overwriting, and creating dashboards and charts, including interactions with dashboards, tabs, and chart states.

classes.name: SaveModal
classes.description: A React component class for managing the 'Save Chart' modal dialog, handling chart and dashboard saving logic, user interactions, and dashboard modifications.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Lifecycle method to load dashboard info and tabs after component mounts.

methods.name: loadDashboards
methods.description: Fetches list of dashboards matching search criteria.

methods.name: loadTabs
methods.description: Loads dashboard tab hierarchy for selection.

methods.name: saveOrOverwrite
methods.description: Saves or overwrites a chart, creating dashboards or slices as needed, and optionally redirects.

methods.name: addChartToDashboardTab
methods.description: Adds a chart to a specific dashboard tab, creating rows if necessary.

methods.name: renderSaveChartModal
methods.description: Renders the modal form for saving charts.

methods.name: renderFooter
methods.description: Renders modal footer with action buttons.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method for the component.
